channels.description: Socket Mode: an outbound, app-token-authenticated WebSocket carries Events API envelopes without a public callback URL
channels.name: socket

steps: Create or open the Slack app for this installation
Enable Socket Mode and create an app-level token with connections:write
Add app_mentions:read and, when selected, channels:history to Bot Token Scopes
Subscribe to app_mention and, when selected, message.channels
Install or reinstall the app, then add it to every channel it should observe
Choose Add Slack and enter each requested credential in the protected prompt

channels.description: Events API webhook: Slack posts signed event_callback envelopes to the Connector-owned callback
channels.name: events-api

steps: Enable Event Subscriptions for the Slack app
Paste the Connector-owned Request URL and complete Slack's URL verification
Subscribe to the selected bot events and grant their Bot Token Scopes
Enter the signing secret in the protected completion flow
Install or reinstall the app so subscription and scope changes take effect
